items.title: SwarmWright, structured multi-agent AI defined in markdowns
items.raw_excerpt: I had a bunch of custom AI pipelines and a growing folder of markdown files and Python scripts holding it together. Built this to give that chaos some structure. Agents are markdown files, topology is a JSON file the runtime enforces hard. The agents are still fully autonomous: they make their own decisions, but the graph they operate in isn't. You declare who can call whom upfront and the runtime holds that line. No auth yet, fine if you don't expose the port, i guess. Two Docker commands to run it.

excerpt_i18n.en: I had a bunch of custom AI pipelines and a growing folder of markdown files and Python scripts holding it together. Built this to give that chaos some structure. Agents are markdown files, topology is a JSON file the runtime enforces hard. The agents are still fully autonomous: they make their own decisions, but the graph they operate in isn't. You declare who can call whom upfront and the runtime holds that line. No auth yet, fine if you don't expose the port, i guess. Two Docker commands to run it.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我有一堆自定义的AI流水线，以及一个不断增长的文件夹，里面装着markdown文件和Python脚本，勉强维持着一切。构建这个工具是为了给那团混乱带来一些结构。智能体是markdown文件，拓扑结构是一个JSON文件，运行时使用。
excerpt_i18n.es: Tenía un montón de pipelines de IA personalizados y una carpeta cada vez más grande de archivos markdown y scripts de Python que lo mantenían todo unido. excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, the competitive logic of on-device AI has shifted. The focus of industry discussions is moving from whether models can run to whether capabilities can be continuously deployed, stably optimized, and truly integrated into the system's main path. Agent OS, system-native agents, cross-app execution, and on-device privacy protection—these once scattered technical keywords—are now converging toward a single direction: on-device agentification. What truly determines the next phase of competitive landscape is no longer just model parameter scale or chip peak computing power, but who can turn agent capabilities into a deployable, optimizable, and replicable engineering system. At the MediaTek Dimensity Developer Conference (MDDC 2026), MediaTek sought to address precisely this question. At the conference, MediaTek integrated the Dimensity AI development suite, system-native agent capabilities, and gaming technology system into a unified narrative. What it emphasized was no longer just chip performance, but how the Dimensity platform can serve as a truly usable on-device AI foundation for developers and a viable implementation base for system vendors. MediaTek Director, General Manager, and COO Chen Kuan-chou stated: "Agent AI is reshaping and upgrading an increasing number of industries and application scenarios. MediaTek empowers the 'agentified experience' with a full-stack, diverse technology and product portfolio covering smartphones, automotive, IoT, and AI infrastructure, leveraging ubiquitous powerful computing power combined with advanced cloud AI acceleration technology to open up pathways for global ecosystem partners—from creativity to large-scale implementation, from application value to commercial success."
excerpt_i18n.es: El año pasado, la lógica competitiva de la IA en el lado del dispositivo ya ha cambiado. El enfoque de las discusiones en la industria está pasando de si el modelo puede ejecutarse a si las capacidades pueden implementarse de manera continua, optimizarse de forma estable y realmente integrarse en la ruta principal del sistema. Términos técnicos que antes estaban dispersos, como Agent OS, agentes nativos del sistema, ejecución entre aplicaciones y protección de la privacidad en el dispositivo, también están convergiendo en una misma dirección: la agentización en el lado del dispositivo. Lo que realmente determinará el panorama competitivo de la próxima etapa ya no es solo la escala de los parámetros del modelo o la potencia máxima de cálculo del chip, sino quién puede convertir las capacidades de los agentes en un sistema de ingeniería desplegable, optimizable y replicable.
